title: Concept: Pod declared from a local path
description: Podfile declares a pod resolved from a directory on the build machine, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a pod resolved from a directory on the build machine.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Podfile (cocoapods).
risk: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a pod resolved from a directory on the build machine.
